### Prerequisites - [X] I understand and accept the project's [code of conduct](https://github.com/PrestaShop/PrestaShop/blob/develop/CODE_OF_CONDUCT.md) - [X] I have already [searched in existing issues](https://github.com/PrestaShop/PrestaShop/issues?q=is%3Aissue+label%3ABug) and found no previous report of this bug. ### Describe the bug and add screenshots >Edited by Khouloud Steps to reproduce the issue: 1. Enable Multistore & Create new Group shop with Share quantity = enabled 2. Create a shop assiciated to this Group shop 3. Create a product with quantity = 0 & allowed for order 4. Go to FO of the shop2 > Category list 5. See error > The product is displayed with out-of-stock flag ![image](https://user-images.githubusercontent.com/16067358/153606126-320f965a-e2e0-4302-b44a-9dd91f947656.png) Hello, i'm back with my bug and i found the cause: On catagory page i have product display as out of stock even if the product is availlable for order. But if I access to the product page, status is ok and product can be added on cart. More, when I add the product to cart, the status on category page change for the good status until the product are removed from the cart. Not all product are affected. I searched in code and the problem come from the out_of_sotck parameter to define if you can order product out of stock. For some product the value of out_of_stock is empty on category page instead of 0,1 or 2. In this case it should be 1. **Product.php line 5579:** ` $row['allow_oosp'] = Product::isAvailableWhenOutOfStock($row['out_of_stock']);` Problem is only on category page. Home page, product page, search page are ok. To avoid loosing customer i disable message on category page ![123515636-7b7b8e00-d698-11eb-853f-76c3ce5b1a0c](https://user-images.githubusercontent.com/25029253/152675137-c44cd4ee-ffaf-4ccd-960f-0c635e5b574b.png) ![128632685-d1507f7f-9bf3-4c52-8459-34b62a81d6ac](https://user-images.githubusercontent.com/25029253/152675149-ebaed18e-23ac-48ef-9cbf-82baae25733f.png) ![128632731-46a0e0c9-5313-4dec-85c8-4040db14b05a](https://user-images.githubusercontent.com/25029253/152675154-59fd6ed0-5b2b-4ae7-8363-faadd7b23f43.png) ![128632843-5d73b17b-3530-48b5-939e-0583711376be](https://user-images.githubusercontent.com/25029253/152675158-4444a40f-40ce-4183-8e0b-edaba510dff0.png) I try to come back on the classic theme to identify if the problem occurs too. At first glance, no message is displaying and it seems to be normal. But classic theme doesn't display out of stock or allows order by default. If stock equal 0, no message is displayed. I try with not allow and allow order: **themes/classic/templates/catalog/_partials/product-flags.tpl** ``` {block name='product_flags'}
    {foreach from=$product.flags item=flag}
  • {$flag.label}
    • {/foreach}
{/block} ``` But if i add the check on allow on order (product.allow_oosp) and display message, we can see that property is not initialize with correct value on catalog part and availability message is wrong : **themes/classic/templates/catalog/_partials/product-flags.tpl** ``` {block name='product_flags'}
    {if $product.quantity > 0} {foreach from=$product.flags item=flag}
  • {$flag.label}
    • {/foreach} {else} {if !$product.allow_oosp}
  • {$product.availability_message}
    • {/if} {/if}
{/block} ``` **Root cause :** After a long investigation, i found that : On class ProductAssemblerCore (ProductAssembler.php in classes foler), there is a SQL request that seach information for product. This request seach stock information by product shop and don't take account that stock is configurated to share stock 👍 ``` LEFT JOIN {$prefix}stock_available sa ON sa.id_product = p.id_product AND sa.id_shop = $idShop ``` ![image](https://user-images.githubusercontent.com/25029253/152675471-d815e5f1-9383-4833-ae81-d25d5d5c89ac.png) So on category page for shared stock management between shop, information about stock are wrong ### Expected behavior When a product is availlable for order even if its qty equal 0, display on demand on category page. ### Steps to reproduce **You need to have multishop with shared product stock** 1. Define product witch capability to be order even if stock are equal to 0 2. Define stock to 0 3. Show product on category page 4. Flag is out of stock instead of On-demand ### PrestaShop version(s) where the bug happened 1.7.8.3 ### PHP version(s) where the bug happened 7.4 ### If your bug is related to a module, specify its name and its version _No response_
